title: Code-Graph RAG Custom Data Ingestion Schema
description: Standard schema for ingesting custom entities, relationships, and metadata into Memgraph + vector database. Designed to be compatible with the Thinking Maps taxonomy (8 relationship categories, 7 entity categories) while remaining flexible for domain-specific extensions. Entities and relationships use emoji+text format for UI readability. THIS IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR ALL JSON INGESTION.

metadata.description: Top-level metadata applied to all entities and relationships in this dataset

dataset_id.description: Required unique identifier for the entire dataset (used for deduplication and bulk deletion)

source.description: Optional source attribution for the data

created_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of when the dataset was generated

default_entity_labels.description: Optional default labels to apply to all entities if no labels are specified on individual entities

schema_version.description: Optional schema version identifier for forward compatibility

taxonomy_reference.description: Optional reference to the taxonomy system used (e.g., 'thinking-maps-v3.0')

operation.description: Optional default operation for all entities/relationships in this batch (overridden by per-entity/relationship operation values if present). Defaults to 'add' if not specified.

batch_id.description: Optional unique ID for this ingestion batch, used for audit tracking and idempotency guarantees

last_updated.description: Optional default last updated timestamp for all entities/relationships in this batch (overridden by per-entity/relationship timestamps if present), used for incremental update change detection

entities.description: List of graph nodes (entities) to ingest. Compatible with the 7-category entity taxonomy (🧱 Concrete Entity, ⏱️ Event/Process, 📨 Information/Expression, 📏 Property/Attribute, 🏗️ System/Structure, 🎭 Agent/Role, 💡 Abstract Concept) but supports domain-specific types. Names use emoji+text format for UI readability.

id.description: Optional unique entity ID within the dataset (auto-generated if not provided). Will be required in v2.0.

name.description: Required human-readable name of the entity. Must start with emoji followed by space and text for UI readability (e.g. '👤 CTO Role', '🧱 Database Server'). Used for deduplication if no ID is provided.

type.description: Optional primary type of the entity. Compatible with taxonomy categories (🧱 Concrete Entity, ⏱️ Event/Process, 📨 Information/Expression, 📏 Property/Attribute, 🏗️ System/Structure, 🎭 Agent/Role, 💡 Abstract Concept) or domain-specific types (e.g., 'Role', 'Mindset', 'Competency').

labels.description: Optional list of labels to apply to the graph node (e.g. ['Job', 'Skill'])

operation.description: Optional operation for this specific entity, overrides batch-level default operation

last_updated.description: Optional last updated timestamp for this specific entity, overrides batch-level default timestamp

properties.description: Arbitrary key-value properties to attach to the graph node

description.description: Recommended default field used for embedding generation (used for semantic search)

relationships.description: List of graph relationships between entities. Compatible with the 8-category Thinking Maps taxonomy (🌳 Hierarchical, 🧩 Compositional, 🎯 Contextual, 💭 Attribute, ⚖️ Comparative, ⏩ Sequential, ⚡ Causal, 🌉 Analogical) but supports domain-specific verbs. All fields use emoji+text format for UI readability. Note: comma-separated targets are deprecated and will be rejected in v2.0.

source.description: Required source entity name or ID (matches entities[].name or entities[].id). Must start with emoji followed by space and text for UI readability.

target.description: Required target entity name or ID. Must start with emoji followed by space and text for UI readability. Note: comma-separated multiple targets are deprecated (will be rejected in v2.0).

relationship.description: Required relationship type. Compatible with Thinking Maps taxonomy categories: 🌳 Hierarchical (is-a, classifies-as), 🧩 Compositional (part-of, comprises), 🎯 Contextual (located-in, provides-context-for), 💭 Attribute (has-property, exhibits), ⚖️ Comparative (similar-to, contrasts-with), ⏩ Sequential (precedes, follows), ⚡ Causal (causes, enables), 🌉 Analogical (analogous-to, maps-to). Format: emoji + space + verb (e.g. '🌳 is a', '⚡ causes'). Domain-specific verbs allowed.

operation.description: Optional operation for this specific relationship, overrides batch-level default operation

last_updated.description: Optional last updated timestamp for this specific relationship, overrides batch-level default timestamp

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for the relationship (0-1), used for conflict resolution

explanation.description: Optional explanation for the relationship (used for relationship embedding generation if provided)

isInferred.description: Optional flag indicating if the relationship was inferred vs manually curated

source.description: Required source entity name or ID (matches entities[].name or entities[].id). Must start with emoji followed by space and text for UI readability.

target.description: Required target entity name or ID. Must start with emoji followed by space and text for UI readability. Note: comma-separated multiple targets are deprecated (will be rejected in v2.0).

relationship.description: Required relationship type. Compatible with Thinking Maps taxonomy categories. Format: emoji + space + verb. Domain-specific verbs allowed.

operation.description: Optional operation for this specific relationship, overrides batch-level default operation

last_updated.description: Optional last updated timestamp for this specific relationship, overrides batch-level default timestamp

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for the relationship (0-1), used for conflict resolution

explanation.description: Optional explanation for the relationship (used for relationship embedding generation if provided)

isInferred.description: Optional flag indicating if the relationship was inferred vs manually curated
